purpose: Implement the isolated fail-closed organic cadence envelope for the Autonomous APK Social Growth Engine, reusing the authoritative 70/20/10 editorial policy without enabling production outbound or paid promotion.
requiredInvariants: Only the fixed Russian-channel allowlist is accepted at runtime; unknown channels fail closed.
Timestamps require explicit RFC 3339 offsets; malformed, duplicate, excessive and materially future history fails closed instead of being ignored.
Daily caps use the Europe/Moscow operating day and channel-specific minimum intervals.
Audience and angle rotation is deterministic, channel-local and bounded to recent history.
The existing editorial core remains authoritative for the 70/20/10 useful, product-proof and conversion mix.
Pain-based angles are not selected for product-proof or conversion slots.
No copy generation, production credentials, social-account connection, outbound enablement, paid mode, database mutation, DNS change or REG.RU deployment.
No cold-DM automation, fake engagement, account farming, CAPTCHA bypass or platform-rule circumvention.
New mandatory and recurring spend remains 0 RUB.
acceptance: API typecheck passes on the exact PR head.
Cadence tests prove strict request and history validation, Moscow-day caps, channel intervals, deterministic rotation and bounded history.
Cadence decisions inherit the authoritative 70/20/10 editorial pillar policy and exclude pain-based promotional angles.
The existing marketing exact-head gate executes both editorial-core and cadence-planner tests with immutable action revisions.
Every changed non-governance path is contained in allowedPaths.
